name: JellyfinOnDemand
description: On-demand discovery and playback for Jellyfin. Expands search beyond the local library and can resolve titles into immediate streams, virtual-library entries, or conventional downloads. Derived from Jellyfin Enhanced; independent community project — not affiliated with Jellyfin or Jellyfin Enhanced.

versions.changelog:
- Product identity: Jellyfin on Demand (new plugin GUID; display/API/docs aligned).
 - Discover pane, Play/Lucky swarm path, search history, cache-to-library, .strm Stream option.
